g.text: Strictly sequential. No agents run in parallel; tool calls inside one model reply run one after another. Human approval is only at the Review Queue.
A. Check a claim (no model call): POST /api/audit-claim
B. Ask Analyst: POST /api/chat/ask (sequential, at most 12 model trips)
repeat model <-> tools until an answer, max 12 trips
answer shown with ungrounded-figure warning if any
score all 4,503 claims with the claim checker
store tiers, stock alerts, stockist profiles
approve or reject a filed claim
No parallel agent execution. No cross-agent LLM handoff. No automatic credit, recovery or
set-off: every money decision waits for a named person.
